text:
Missed/held scan passes, Nov 16, 18 and 20. Source: the scheduled-task records (list_triggers). Limitation: the records keep only each task's LAST run (status, fired_at, finished_at) plus updated_at and last_fired_at; there is no per-slot run history, so a per-slot status and reason cannot be read directly. All last_run entries show SUCCEEDED with failure_reason UNSPECIFIED; no reason text (computer asleep, Chrome not reachable, another run in progress, usage limit) is recorded anywhere.

Fri 20 Nov, 09:00 premarket + unusualvol (14:00Z) and 09:34/09:39/09:44 opening (14:34Z): NOT STARTED at the slot, then released. The premarket, opening and mover-open tasks were all re-enabled (updated_at) at 16:16:55Z; the premarket task fired at 16:17:03Z and the opening task at 16:17:07Z (11:17 ET), opening run finished 16:28:49Z, premarket 16:35:32Z. These tasks require the computer (breadgoat-asustuf) and are suspended when it is absent, then re-enabled when it returns; this pattern matches a 'computer absent' hold (asleep, offline or desktop app closed). Not consistent with a usage limit or another run in progress (those would not re-enable the task). Each held slot ran once on release, so 'held then released', not 'started and waited'.
Fri 20 Nov, 10:00 mid (15:00Z): NOT STARTED, dropped. Mid on-the-hour task re-enabled at 16:10:01Z, after the 15:00Z slot; no 2026-11-20-mid-1500 doc. Dropped rather than released.
Wed 18 Nov, 12:00-14:00 ET mid (17:00-19:00Z): NOT STARTED. Half-past and last-hour tasks re-enabled at 20:39:46Z, which covers those slots; same 'computer absent' hold pattern. The on-the-hour task's record for that day has since been overwritten.
Mon 16 Nov, 12:00-14:00 ET mid: NOT STARTED; device-absent suspensions are visible on Nov 16-17, but per-slot detail cannot be confirmed from the records.
Fix in place: keep the computer awake with the Claude desktop app open 14:30-23:30 SAST. On Nov 21 the premarket and mid tasks were moved to fire 1 minute after their slots (08:01/09:01, :01, :31 ET) to avoid the scheduler's ~9-minute spread on round times; doc ids and late still use the :00/:30 slot.
